d.ko: Monster Train is a strategic roguelike deck building game with a twist. Set on a train to hell, you’ll use tactical decision making to defend multiple vertical battlegrounds. With real time competitive multiplayer and endless replayability, Monster Train is always on time.
d.en: Monster Train is a strategic roguelike deck building game with a twist. Set on a train to hell, you’ll use tactical decision making to defend multiple vertical battlegrounds. With real time competitive multiplayer and endless replayability, Monster Train is always on time.
d.zh: 《怪物火车》是一款特别的 Roguelike 卡牌构筑策略类游戏。登上前往地狱的火车，巧妙地运用战术来守卫多个纵向战场。多名玩家实时竞技，无限重玩的游戏机制，《怪物火车》能够随时为您带来欢乐。

rv.t: 개인적으로 슬더스보다 이게 더 재밌음 층이 있는 기차에 몹을 배치한다는 점이 독특함
로그라이크, 카드겜 좋아하면 재밌게 할 수 있음. 하스스톤 모험모드 좋아하면 재밌게 할 듯. 여러가지로 해볼 수 있어서 지겹지 않게 다회차 가능 8/10
There is something so perfect and magical about this game. Slay the Spire gets a lot of credit, but I believe Monster Train's added placement/level mechanics adds so much to the genre.

I'm new to rogue-like deck builders but I've had a lot of fun with Monster Train. It eases you in and becomes more challenging the better you get at the game so you're forced to come up with new plays to try and win. …

以前我不喜欢卡牌游戏，直到我遇到火车，原来我不喜欢的是小作文、范围值和一上来一大堆机制糊脸，因为这些火车都没有。 火车每个氏族都有自己的特色机制，一句话能讲清楚每个词条，自己摸索起来很舒服。 …
类杀戮尖塔，美术精美，三层式战场很独到，刷精通卡框、氏族融合（极大的丰富了战术和玩法）和卡组日志系统的设计也都值得好评，这三个设计同类游戏都可以借鉴。 …
